title: Tech & Sun Round
summary: Solar-powered container hubs with internet for student builders. The first opened at Nnamdi Azikiwe University in Awka in March 2026; a second, at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka, will be completed when more funding comes in.
description: Tech & Sun (TAS) brings reliable power, internet and Web3 education to Nigerian universities. The Awka hub hosts weekly learning days of 8 to 10 hours, and the round was matched through Localism Fund Round 1.
